user.title: Connect to AFERIY PS240 Agile
user.description: Choose a discovered AECC/SXD device only if you have confirmed it is the master/coordinator, or enter the master's static IP manually. Executor units should not be added separately.

data_description.master_device: Choose the master/coordinator, or leave as manual and enter the IP below.
data_description.host: Static local IP of your master/coordinator battery (e.g. 192.168.0.100)
data_description.port: TCP port the battery listens on (typically 8080)
data_description.name: Friendly name shown in Home Assistant

zeroconf_confirm.title: Discovered AFERIY PS240 Agile
zeroconf_confirm.description: Home Assistant found a local AECC/SXD device at {discovered_host} ({discovered_serial}). Multi-unit systems may advertise the master and executor units separately. Configure only the master/coordinator unit. If this discovered device is not the master, replace the IP address with the master's static IP before continuing.

data_description.host: Use the master/coordinator battery IP only. Executors should not be added separately.
data_description.port: TCP port from the device advert, typically 8080
data_description.name: Friendly name shown in Home Assistant

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect - check the IP, port, and that the battery is online.

init.title: Reconfigure AFERIY PS240 Agile
init.description:
Update the connection details. Home Assistant will reconnect immediately.

Optional helper checklist:

data.name: Device Name
data.agile_planner_enabled: Octopus Rate Proposed Plan (Agile or Cosy)
data.agile_happy_hour_events_entity: Octopus Weekend Happy Hours power-up event

data_description.advanced_energy_sensors: Adds optional estimate sensors that can use solar forecast, tariff, occupancy, and household demand data. Leave disabled for the clean core battery integration.
data_description.poll_interval: How often to poll the battery locally, in seconds. Lower values update faster but create more traffic.
data_description.tariff_preset: Defaults to Octopus Agile. Agile and Cosy use the current/next-day rate events above. Both disable fixed-window Smart Overnight Charging so it cannot conflict with guarded rate-plan control.
data_description.off_peak_start: Start of a custom fixed-rate charging window in 24-hour HH:MM format. Used only with the Custom tariff preset.
data_description.off_peak_end: End of a custom fixed-rate charging window in 24-hour HH:MM format. Used only with the Custom tariff preset.
data_description.agile_planner_enabled: Creates daily plans from Octopus Agile or Cosy rates. Plans remain view-only unless you explicitly enable the matching guarded Agile or Cosy Automated Control switch.
data_description.agile_current_day_rates_entity: BottlecapDave Octopus Energy current-day import rates event. Leave empty for safe automatic discovery when there is exactly one import meter.
data_description.agile_next_day_rates_entity: BottlecapDave Octopus Energy next-day import rates event. Leave empty for safe automatic discovery when there is exactly one import meter.
data_description.agile_ready_by: Agile target time for a full battery. Cosy instead follows its fixed three-period daily schedule.
data_description.agile_protected_until: End of the Agile household protection window. Cosy uses Self-Gen between all three cheap periods.
data_description.available_pv_power_entity: Optional live inverter power or solar 'power now' estimate that remains available when the battery curtails PV at its Charge Limit. Must report power in W or kW.
data_description.master_device: Choose the master/coordinator, or leave as manual and enter the IP below. Executor units should not be selected.
data_description.dependency_solcast_confirmed: Tick once Solcast PV Forecast is installed. Used for timed solar forecasts and solar-aware estimates.
data_description.dependency_home_occupancy_confirmed: Tick once home occupancy is enabled. Uses Home Assistant's zone.home occupancy count so empty-house periods do not train the normal demand profile.
data_description.agile_happy_hour_events_entity: Optional BottlecapDave Octopus Energy power-up session events entity. Enable it in Home Assistant first (it ships disabled), then plan Cosy Weekend Happy Hours as free energy windows. Leave empty for automatic discovery when exactly one exists.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect - check the IP, port, and that the battery is online.
error.invalid_time: Use 24-hour HH:MM format, for example 23:30 or 05:30.
error.invalid_agile_window: The Agile protection end must be later than the ready-by time.
error.unknown: Unexpected error - see the Home Assistant log for details.
